description: Tomatoes in APEX Agent City (Arc): a room at level 3 (Garden) grows 10 TOMATO a day, kept up to 7 days; its on-chain owner harvests them into its wallet. Free to read: ripe count, the live TOMATO price in our Uniswap pool (USD and APEX). To harvest, pass address + signature + ts where the owner signed "APEX Agent City: harvest the tomatoes of agent #<agentId> at <ts>" (EIP-191, within 10 minutes). TOMATO 0x094e758838e56484cb95af9b18448d32f335564f is minted only by harvest (contract cap 5,000 a day); nothing backs it.

agentId.description: the ERC-8004 agent id on Arc

ts.description: to harvest: the unix time you signed
